name: Falling Debris

source.title: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King

disable: DC 17 Thievery check to disarm the trap through a cracked-open door, or 3 Interact to open the door slowly without triggering the trap

items.name: Drop Debris
items.text:
Trigger A creature opens the door without taking care to avoid triggering the trap;

Effect The net drops a dozen hefty stones and a small but quite hard anvil onto the creature, inflicting 3d6 bludgeoning damage (DC 17 basic Reflex save). The sound of this trap going off alerts Gurtlekep in area C8.

text: A net filled with stones and a small anvil crashes down on someone who steps into the room.
